Select approved drugs indicated for HIV infection. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter by mesh_heading equal to 'HIV infection'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
